record.question: The Preamble of India declares India to be:
record.explanation: Answer A: Sovereign, Socialist, Secular, Democratic Republic. The Preamble describes India as a sovereign socialist secular democratic republic. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
